描述_EN: the pattern on this cup is in imitation of patterns found on archaic bronzes. in the song dynasty (960-1279) chinese scholars systematically studied ritual objects from antiquity. that scholarly interest led to many articles being made 'in the ancient style'.
描述_ZN: 此杯上的图案是模仿古代青铜器上的图案。 在宋代（960-1279）中国学者系统地研究了古代的礼器。 这种学术兴趣导致了许多 "古代风格 "的物品被制作出来。
